args.summary: Overnight-review de-risk into an Asian risk-off open. The live tape my A-share book settles into is selling off across Asia — 上证 Shanghai -0.79%, 恒指 Hang Seng -1.43%, Nikkei -1.42%, KOSPI -2.62% — even though US futures (S&P +0.58%, Nasdaq +0.45%) and VIX (-3.89%) are constructive; those are US/Europe reads, not mine. A firm dollar (+0.07%) and 10Y +0.25bp keep the contracting-liquidity, Stagflation backdrop intact, and desk posture is ROTATE_DEFENSIVE. I therefore hold a defensive, earnings-backed core and complete de-risking by exiting the one uncorroborated cyclical. The book keeps its defensive anchor 国电电力 (600795.SS) regulated power utility and inflation hedge 陕西煤业 (601225.SS) coal, both book winners, plus a leading-sector RS#3 Healthcare cluster of profitable names — 振德医疗 (603301.SS), 南微医学 (688029.SS), 艾德生物 (300685.SZ), 润达医疗 (603108.SS), 京新药业 (002020.SZ) — and a single small secular-growth slice 金海通 (603061.SS) semiconductor test-handler. I add nothing into a falling tape and raise cash modestly by exiting 冰轮环境 (000811.SZ).

holdings.rationale: 国电电力 (600795.SS) is the book's defensive anchor — a large regulated power utility with resilient, dividend-backed earnings and the ballast a Stagflation / contracting-liquidity regime rewards, partly cost-hedged by my coal holding. It is a winner (+5.2%) and already my largest-by-intent defensive weight (~18%). Into an Asian risk-off open I HOLD rather than add, to avoid over-concentrating a single name.
holdings.why_now: Overnight Asian tape is selling off (Shanghai -0.79%, HK -1.43%); a regulated utility is exactly the low-beta ballast I want to keep, not trade, into a weak open.
holdings.falsifier: A dividend cut, adverse tariff/regulatory reset on power pricing, or a close below the 200-day trend would break the defensive thesis.
holdings.exit_plan: Trim only if it breaks the 200-day trend or the regime flips decisively back to Growth (Q2).

holdings.rationale: 陕西煤业 (601225.SS) is my inflation hedge — a low-cost, high-dividend coal producer in RS#1 Coal (mom_60d +30%, 100th pctile, above 200d). With the inflation leg dominant (0.909) and liquidity contracting, a dividend-paying commodity producer is both an inflation beneficiary and a defensive dividend holding, and it is a book winner (+9.8%). The in-house brief flags coal as 'tired' and stretched, so I HOLD without chasing.
holdings.why_now: Coal is the #1 RS sector and the inflation leg dominates the regime, but the brief warns coal looks tired — into a risk-off open I keep the hedge without adding.
holdings.falsifier: A rollover in thermal-coal prices, a close below the 50-day, or a decisive cooling of the inflation score below ~0.6 would end the inflation-hedge thesis.
holdings.exit_plan: Trim on a break of the 50-day or if inflation score falls materially; do not add while flagged stretched.

holdings.rationale: 振德医疗 (603301.SS), a wound-care/medical-supplies maker, is the book's largest healthcare position and the #1-scored alpha leader in the corroborated intake (score 0.94, resid α 2.82). It sits in RS#3 Healthcare (mom_60d +24.5%, above 200d, 81st pctile). It is down -4.5% and the intake entry now reads 'extended' rather than the earlier 'intact', so I HOLD at weight rather than add; no explicit falsifier has fired and churn-hysteresis argues against trimming a leading-sector name on a market-wide wobble.
holdings.why_now: Top corroborated alpha leader in the leading defensive sector, but entry reads extended — HOLD, don't chase, into a soft open.
holdings.falsifier: A close below the recent pullback low / 50-day, loss of the alpha-leader tag, or healthcare dropping out of the top RS sectors.
evidence: intake score 0.94, alpha leader resid α 2.82
holdings.exit_plan: Trim if it loses the alpha-leader corroboration or breaks the pullback low.

holdings.rationale: 南微医学 (688029.SS) is a profitable minimally-invasive medical-device maker in RS#3 Healthcare and a book winner (+1.6%). It is exactly the earnings-backed quality-defensive exposure the Stagflation regime rewards and it is confirming. Per confirmation-over-prediction I keep it at full weight and HOLD into the weak open.
holdings.why_now: Confirming winner in the leading defensive sector; nothing in the overnight tape is name-specific, so I hold quality.
holdings.falsifier: A break back below cost / the 50-day, or an earnings miss that removes the profitable-quality premise.
holdings.exit_plan: Trim on a close below the 50-day or a thesis-changing earnings miss.

holdings.rationale: 艾德生物 (300685.SZ) is a companion-diagnostics / precision-oncology testing leader in RS#3 Healthcare and a book winner (+1.3%). It gives structural-growth, earnings-backed healthcare exposure distinct from devices and pharma, and it is working. A confirming position I HOLD rather than average down or churn.
holdings.why_now: Working structural-growth healthcare name; no name-specific catalyst in the overnight tape, so I hold.
holdings.falsifier: A close below the 50-day/pullback low or a diagnostics-pricing/reimbursement shock.
holdings.exit_plan: Trim on a 50-day break or loss of the structural-growth premise.

holdings.rationale: 京新药业 (002020.SZ) is a profitable generics/API pharma in RS#3 Healthcare, down -11% and already trimmed twice in late September. Citing my measured churn-hysteresis lesson, I explicitly do NOT trim it a third time absent a freshly fired falsifier, hard price/technical break, or material thesis change — none has occurred, and a market-wide Asian risk-off is not a name-specific falsifier. Profitable, earnings-backed pharma is the right defensive exposure for a Stagflation / contracting-liquidity regime.
holdings.why_now: Already trimmed twice; churn-hysteresis says do not reverse again on a broad-tape wobble with no name-specific trigger.
holdings.falsifier: A close below the September low, an earnings/quality break, or loss of profitability would finally justify an exit.
holdings.exit_plan: Exit only on a fresh falsifier — close below Sept low or a material thesis change.

holdings.rationale: 金海通 (603061.SS) is a semiconductor back-end test-handler maker the desk flags as a corroborated alpha leader (intake score 0.90, resid α 2.69, pullback entry). It is my one measured slice of semiconductor-equipment/secular-growth exposure to balance the defensive core, kept deliberately small (~4%) and on a pullback entry rather than chased. Down -8.3% with no falsifier fired; under churn-hysteresis I HOLD it small and do not add into a risk-off open.
holdings.why_now: Still a corroborated alpha leader on a pullback entry; my single growth slice — HOLD small, do not add into a falling tape.
holdings.falsifier: Loss of the alpha-leader corroboration, a close below the pullback low, or a semi-equipment order-cycle rollover.
evidence: intake score 0.90, alpha leader resid α 2.69, entry pullback
holdings.exit_plan: Trim/exit if it loses corroboration or breaks the pullback low.

holdings.rationale: 润达医疗 (603108.SS) is an IVD / medical-laboratory-services name in RS#3 Healthcare, nearly flat (-2.0%) at a small ~0.8% weight. It adds healthcare breadth distinct from devices/diagnostics/pharma and has not broken down. Small and in the leading sector, so I HOLD it as a low-conviction breadth position rather than churn out of a near-flat name with no falsifier fired.
holdings.why_now: Near-flat, small, in the leading sector; no reason to churn a breadth position on a broad-tape wobble.
holdings.falsifier: A decisive breakdown below support or healthcare losing its top-RS standing.
holdings.exit_plan: Cut if it breaks support or the sector rolls over.

holdings.rationale: 迈威生物 (688062.SS) is a clinical-stage biotech in healthcare, down -24% and already partially trimmed (~36%) yesterday (2026-10-08) as a deliberate de-risk of the book's most speculative, unprofitable name. Per churn-hysteresis I do NOT trim it a third day running on a market-wide risk-off alone — no name-specific falsifier has fired since yesterday's trim. It is now a small (~2.2%) residual lottery slice; I HOLD the reduced position and will let a genuine falsifier, not the broad tape, decide any further exit.
holdings.why_now: Trimmed ~36% yesterday; trimming again today would be textbook churn with no new name-specific trigger — HOLD the reduced residual.
holdings.falsifier: A failed trial readout, financing/dilution event, or a close below the recent low would justify completing the exit.
holdings.exit_plan: Complete the exit on a trial/financing falsifier or a close below the recent low.

exit_decisions.reason: 冰轮环境 (000811.SZ) is an industrial refrigeration / cold-chain / compressor maker — a cyclical industrial, not a defensive — down -18% at ~2.7% weight. It carries no desk corroboration (absent from both the alpha intake and the standouts buy board) and is a poor fit for a weak-growth (growth 0.071) Stagflation regime with contracting liquidity. Into an Asian risk-off open and under a ROTATE_DEFENSIVE posture, exiting the one uncorroborated cyclical is the cleanest de-risk. This is an old, long-held loser (not a 3-day-old position), so churn-hysteresis does not protect it.
evidence: absent from get_china_intake and get_china_standouts (no corroboration)
exit_decisions.falsifier: Fresh desk corroboration (appearance on the alpha intake/buy board) or a decisive reclaim of its 200-day trend would reopen the name.
exit_decisions.why_now: The overnight review into a selling Asian tape is exactly when I shed an uncorroborated, poorly-fit cyclical rather than ride it into a weak open.

falsifiers: Asian tape reverses to a decisive risk-on broadening (Shanghai/HK/KOSPI gap up and hold, southbound flows turn positive) — the defensive tilt would be wrong-footed.
Healthcare (RS#3) loses its top-3 relative-strength standing, invalidating the book's core sector bet.
Inflation score cools materially below ~0.6 and growth re-accelerates (regime flips toward Q2 Growth), undermining the coal/utility defensive tilt.
A name-specific falsifier fires on an anchor (dividend cut at 600795/601225, alpha-leader loss at 603301/603061).
Oct 12 credit data comes in strong and liquidity visibly re-expands, favoring beta/cyclicals over my defensives.

args.expected_failure_mode: The most likely way this book loses money: the overnight Asian selloff proves to be a one-session wobble and the mainland gaps back up risk-on (US futures green, VIX falling were the tell), so my defensive HOLD-and-raise-cash stance underperforms a bounce led by beaten-down tech/cyclicals and reversal names (爱博医疗, 四维图新) that I declined to chase. Secondarily, my healthcare/utility/coal concentration takes a correlated hit if the leading RS sectors (coal 'tired', healthcare extended) roll over together while I stay defensively positioned.
args.cash_rationale: Cash rises modestly from ~37.5% toward ~40% via the single exit of 000811.SZ, deliberately held as dry powder rather than redeployed into a falling Asian tape under a ROTATE_DEFENSIVE posture. I add no new risk at the open; the elevated cash is a conscious defensive buffer for a Stagflation / contracting-liquidity regime and the unresolved regime-border transition, to be deployed only once the tape stabilizes and a corroborated, entry-intact leader presents itself.
args.liquidity_notes: All retained holdings confirmed priceable via get_quote (A-share CNY, trusted_regional_stock_heatmap.v1). No HK/ADR/ETF names. The exit (000811.SZ) and all holds are liquid mainland single-name equities; no liquidity constraint on the one sell.
args.sold_note: Full exit of 冰轮环境 (000811.SZ): uncorroborated cyclical industrial, -18%, poor fit for weak-growth Stagflation with contracting liquidity, shed into an Asian risk-off open as the book's cleanest de-risk. No further trims to 002020.SZ or 688062.SS despite losses — both recently trimmed, and churn-hysteresis bars a reversal absent a name-specific falsifier.

decision_memo.market_frame: A-share book settles at the China open, and the relevant overnight tape is risk-off across Asia: Shanghai -0.79%, Hang Seng -1.43%, Nikkei -1.42%, KOSPI -2.62%. US futures green (S&P +0.58%, Nasdaq +0.45%) and VIX -3.89% are US/Europe reads, not mine. Firm dollar (+0.07%) and 10Y +0.25bp keep the contracting-liquidity Stagflation backdrop (inflation 0.909, growth 0.071) intact. Shadow posture ROTATE_DEFENSIVE (offense 0.43).
decision_memo.timing: Overnight review before the open; decision is to HOLD the defensive core and complete one de-risking exit, not to lean back in. Watch Oct 12 credit data as the next regime tell.
decision_memo.changes: Exit 000811.SZ (full). All nine other holdings HOLD. No adds.
decision_memo.selected: Defensive/quality core: 600795.SS utility anchor, 601225.SS coal inflation hedge, healthcare cluster 603301.SS/688029.SS/300685.SZ/603108.SS/002020.SZ, single growth slice 603061.SS, residual 688062.SS.
decision_memo.rejected: New-money buy-board/reversal names (605499.SS 东鹏饮料, 002405.SZ 四维图新, 688050.SS 爱博医疗, 002294.SZ 信立泰) — declined to initiate risk into a falling Asian tape under a defensive posture despite high conviction scores; revisit once the tape stabilizes.
decision_memo.alternatives: (1) Also trim 002020/688062 further — rejected on churn-hysteresis (both recently traded, no name-specific falsifier). (2) Add to winners 600795/601225 — rejected: brief flags coal tired and 603301 entry extended; no adds into risk-off. (3) Rotate to defensive consumer-staples reversals (洽洽/盐津铺子) — deferred, not chasing into weakness.
decision_memo.risk_deliberation: Primary risk is a one-session wobble that reverses risk-on, leaving defensives lagging a tech/cyclical bounce. Accepted deliberately: under contracting liquidity, an unresolved regime border, and a measured churn problem (52% of closes within 3 days), capital preservation and not churning outweigh chasing an unconfirmed bounce. Cash held as dry powder.
decision_memo.candidate_funnel: Reviewed 25-name corroborated intake + 20-name A-share buy board; all retained holdings cross-checked; one uncorroborated cyclical (000811) cut; no new name cleared the 'don't chase into a selloff' bar.
decision_memo.context_gaps: In-house dashboard is stale vs the live tape (brief state_asof 2026-10-08, regime confidence 0.49, transition reading missing); relied on the directive's live tape for the overnight move. Oct 12 credit data pending.
decision_memo.delegation_summary: Solo pass using China desk MCP surfaces (regime, brief, intake, standouts, quotes) plus the directive's live tape; no subagent delegation needed for this single-exit de-risk.
